# archive-search-link

searchLink(term) returns an absolute HTTPS link to archive.org/search with exactly one query parameter named q. Decoding q must reproduce the entire input string, including spaces, ampersands, plus signs, hashes, slashes, percent signs and Unicode. No fragment or additional parameters are allowed. term is a valid Unicode string, possibly empty.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Preserve the public API and existing tests. Use only Node built-ins; no dependencies or network access.
